name: minecraft
description: Paper plugin scaffolding, server lifecycle, and mineflayer bot harness.

tools.name: plugin_scaffold
tools.description: Create a Paper/Spigot plugin Gradle project with a main class, command and plugin.yml.

path.description: Plugin folder relative to the project root (default "plugin")

tools.name: plugin_build
tools.description: Build the plugin with the Gradle wrapper (or gradle) and report the jar path.

path.description: Plugin folder relative to the project root (default "plugin")

tools.name: server_start
tools.description: Start a Paper/Spigot server jar in the background with a log file and PID state.

path.description: Server folder relative to the project root (default "server")

eula.description: Write eula=true (only if you accept the Minecraft EULA)

tools.name: server_stop
tools.description: Stop the server started by this extension.

path.description: Server folder relative to the project root (default "server")

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Check server process state and show the last log lines.

path.description: Server folder relative to the project root (default "server")

tools.name: bot_install
tools.description: Install mineflayer in the bot folder.

path.description: Bot folder relative to the project root (default "bot")

tools.name: bot_harness
tools.description: Write a mineflayer test bot that connects, spawns, and disconnects after a few seconds.

path.description: Bot folder relative to the project root (default "bot")

tools.name: bot_run
tools.description: Run the generated mineflayer bot for a few seconds and return its output.

path.description: Bot folder relative to the project root (default "bot")
